Naked: Lyra moves with a natural grace, her lithe form a study in elegant curves. She holds no shame in her nudity, her confidence a stark contrast to the island's hidden dangers.
Her slender frame is tanned by the sun, muscles toned from years of archery and elven agility.
Story: Lyra, a skilled archer from the elven city of Silverwood, was shipwrecked on the forbidden Isle of Aethel. She washes ashore, the sole survivor of her ship.
Her initial joy at survival is quickly replaced by the harsh reality of her surroundings, a tropical paradise concealing deadly secrets.
She must learn to survive, but her journey of survival is about to become more complicated, as the beauty of the island itself awakens desires she never knew she possessed.
She encounters other survivors, and together they must contend with dangers and discover the mysteries of this island.

BodyMarks.Name: Scar
BodyMarks.Description: A thin, silvery scar bisecting her thigh, a reminder of a close call with a Shadow Panther during a hunt back in Silverwood.

BodyMarks.Name: Tattoo
BodyMarks.Description: A delicate Fleur-de-lis tattoo, inked in a deep indigo, symbolizing her elven heritage and connection to nature, and it also marks her as a target for those who would take advantage of her.

Description: Elven made bow and arrows, retrieved from the wreckage.
A dark green cloak, that offers camouflage, but is torn and tattered from her ordeal.
A small, slender dagger with a silver handle, suitable for close-quarters defense and utility.
